text:
Maya: hi everyone :wave: i'm Maya, just started today. followed the k8s quickstart but `kubectl get pods` gives me a forbidden/unauthorized error, anyone point me at the right setup step?
Onboard-bot: Welcome Maya! :tada: Make sure you downloaded your kubeconfig from https://redwood.dev/onboarding/kubeconfig and set `KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/redwood-<yourname>`. If that doesn't fix it open an infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/ (or ping #eng-infra).
Maya: i did `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/redwood-maya` and `kubectl config get-contexts` shows `redwood-prod` only. error message: `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User \"user:maya\" cannot list resource \"pods\" at the cluster scope`
Owen: ah — sounds like you're hitting cluster-scope RBAC. First check your current namespace: `kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{.contexts[0].context.namespace}'`. If empty, set your sandbox ns: `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=maya-dev` and try `kubectl get pods -n maya-dev`.
Maya: ran `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=maya-dev` then `kubectl get pods -n maya-dev` but still getting forbidden.
Anna: can you run `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n maya-dev` and paste the output? Also check whether your kubeconfig uses an `exec` credential (OIDC/okta) or a static token under `users` — that helps narrow it down.
Maya: output of `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n maya-dev`: `no`. kubeconfig user entry looks like:
```
user:
  name: maya-onboard
  exec:
    apiVersion: client.authentication.k8s.io/v1beta1
    command: redwood-auth
    args: ["get-token"]
```
Owen: thanks. that shows your identity is fine but you don't have a RoleBinding in the namespace. I'll create a RoleBinding that gives `edit` on `namespace: maya-dev` to `user:maya`.
Owen: :white_check_mark: created RoleBinding `rb-maya-dev-edit` in namespace `maya-dev` and bound `user:maya`. try again.
Maya: works now — `kubectl get pods -n maya-dev` returns the pod list. huge help, thank you!! :pray: :tada: 
Anna: filing a follow-up ticket INFRA-842 to automate sandbox RBAC for new hires and update the onboarding doc.
Maya: awesome. can you drop the doc link so i can add a small note about the kubeconfig path i used? :)
Onboard-bot: Onboarding doc for k8s sandbox: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/kubernetes#sandbox-namespace
